violations.why: The ISR can preempt main between assigning m and dereferencing it. It repoints m to the ISR's local, so main's store at line 37 goes to the wrong object.
The ISR can repoint m between main's two dereferences, so line 38 uses a different target than line 37.
The ISR can read local_var1 through p between main's two writes. It sees the intermediate value 2 rather than the final value 3.
